minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  SPECIAL MEETING
  MINUTES
  April 4, 2019

A special meeting of the Permits and License Committee was held on Thursday, April 4,
2019, at 2:01 pm in the Community Room A, 1st Floor

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk
  Wanda Brown, City Treasurer – 2:05 p.m.
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LACO Fire Department
  Eddy Ikemefuna, Planning & Building Department

  Staff Present:  Peggy Velasquez, Finance Department
  Serena Martinez, Finance Department

Also Present: Maria E. Heaney, Finance Manager and Teresa Estrada-Quintanar,
Superintendent.

Item #1:  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the permit request for
  Laura Santo; dba: Tuner AECOM/ Hunt JV to host a Roof Shell Topping
  Out Event at 1000 S. Prairie Ave. (office parking lot), April 15, 2019, from
  10:45 am – 3:00 pm, subject to Inglewood Police Department (IPD) staffing
  (2 Officers / 1 Sergeant); IPD staffing may change; invoice for Police
  services to be paid five (5) days prior to your event date; hire six (6)
  uniformed security guards from a professional security guard company and
  licensed with the City of Inglewood; contact the Los Angeles County Fire
  Department at (310) 263-2732; maintain site at all times, ensuring site is
  properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; adhere to all
  applicable IMC regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously. (Activity No. 00274262)

  Present: Laura Santo, Project Control Manager, Turner AECOM/ Hunt JV

Item #2:  A motion was moved and seconded to conditionally APPROVE the permit
  request for Kanishia Jackson; dba: Majestic Hearts to host Majestic Hearts
  5k for $5k Walkathon at Darby Park, 3400 W. Arbor Vitae St., April 20,
  2019, from 8:45 am – 11:00, subject to payment of Invoice No. 16692 for
  Inglewood Police Department staffing services is due no later than, Friday,
  April 12, 2019; cost of Parks, Recreation and Community Services staffing,
  two (2) Recreation Leaders cost is TBD (estimated cost under $200) and
  $250 refundable security deposit, due no later than, Friday, April 12, 2019;
  finalized list of parking plan for patrons, participating vendors, certificate of
  insurance, naming the City of Inglewood as additional insured and site
  map, due to the Finance Department, no later than Friday, April 12, 2019;
  amplified sound, inflatable jumpers is strictly prohibited and vendors cannot
  sell clothing representing and/or identifies with gang affiliation; catering
  trucks are prohibited from obstructing park walkways; maintain event site,
  no littering and loitering throughout the event, ensuring site is properly
  cleaned immediately at the end of the event; contact Gina Thierry, Darby
  Park at (310) 412-5391, to coordinate a meeting to discuss site plan and

  event logistics, before April 12, 2019; ensure safe pedestrian and vehicular
  circulation on/off site; adhere to all applicable IMC rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously. (Activity No.
  00274323)

  Present: Kanishia Jackson, Owner, Majestic Hearts

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 2:30 pm.

  Respectfully submitted,
  Peggy L. Velasquez, Recording Secretary
